description: Verify a claim about a web page's content: fetches the page (SSRF-guarded) and reports whether the expected text appears, with the surrounding excerpt as evidence. The deterministic way for an agent to confirm 'the site says X' before acting on it. Use this when an agent needs to does this page actually say that? Checked, not guessed. x402 price $0.002/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_page_verify
title: Page Claim Verifier
